kashika:
विरतिर्विरामः। विरम्यतेऽनेनेति वा विरामः। सोऽवसानसंज्ञो भवति। दधिँ। मधुँ। वृक्षः। प्लक्षः। अवसानप्रदेशाः — <<खरवसानयोर्विसर्जनीयः>> [[८.३.१५]] इत्येवमादयः॥

॥ इति श्रीजयादित्यविरचितायां काशिकायां वृत्तौ प्रथमाध्यायस्य चतुर्थः पादः॥
kashikaEnglish: The absence of a following sound is called avasāna (pause).
englishShort: Absence of letters is called अवसान.
englishFull:
The absence of a following sound is called अवसान (pause/cessation).

**Application:** Rules conditioned by अवसान apply at word-final position before silence.

**Example:** @ref[8.3.15] uses अवसान to condition certain final consonant changes.

**Note:** विराम = stopping, cessation — the end of an utterance.
